message.content: Sure! If you’re looking for a great picnic spot in Miami, consider **South Pointe Park**. It’s located at the southern tip of Miami Beach, right on the waterfront with stunning views of the ocean and the cruise ships that dock there. The park offers plenty of shaded picnic tables, a playground, and easy access to the beach if you want to take a dip afterward. It’s also close to the Miami Beach Boardwalk, so you can stroll along the coast before or after your picnic. Enjoy!
